subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack assistant-thread status display per-tool labels by default, behind a Slack visibility/config mode, or not at all given the Slack progress disclosure policy?
rationale: Current main has generic loading messages, draft-preview tool progress, status reactions, and an open Slack-safe visibility item, so the remaining choice is a product and disclosure-policy decision rather than a narrow wiring fix.

options.title: Gate per-tool status behind safe visibility
options.body: Implement native per-tool status only after or alongside the Slack-safe visibility policy, with coarse labels by default and explicit opt-in for detailed/debug labels.

options.title: Ship simple per-tool labels now
options.body: Wire `onToolStart` directly to `assistant.threads.setStatus`, accepting the risk that Slack threads may reveal tool-level operational detail before the safety policy lands.

options.title: Keep native status generic
options.body: Treat fixed loading messages, status reactions, and draft-progress modes as the supported progress surfaces, and leave native assistant status as a generic processing indicator.

recommendation.title: Gate per-tool status behind safe visibility
recommendation.body: Implement native per-tool status only after or alongside the Slack-safe visibility policy, with coarse labels by default and explicit opt-in for detailed/debug labels.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Slack status work and maintainer verification make this the strongest available routing candidate for the product/disclosure decision.
